No h\/o chest pain, palpitations, sweating, pedal edema , pnd , orthopnea . He was started on medication\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1) T.Aspirin 75 mg\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2) T.Atorvastatin 20 mg\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3) T.Met xl\u0026nbsp; 15 mg\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4) T Lasix 40mg\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe was on regular follow up and on regular medication since then .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2023\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient went with c\/o chest pain radiating to the back , left arm since 1 month .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESob progressed to garde 3 ( MMRC)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o fatigue\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter investigations were done he was notified his creatinine levels were elevated (?CKD) and underwent 2 sessions of\u0026nbsp; dialysis . Later he was planned for renal biopsy but patient was not willing for it so left the hospital.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFrom then he is visiting near by government hospital for medication.(monthly)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBut from last few months he couldn't afford for the medication and he has stopped taking few of the above mentioned medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2024\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient now complains of chest pain radiating to left upper limb since 3 years aggravating on strenuous exercise and no relieving factors associated with sweating on exertion and\u0026nbsp; not associated with palpitations .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o SOB grade 2 MMRC insidious in onset , gradually progressive since 3 years aggravates on exertion and relieves on taking rest .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o cough not associated with expectoration since 10 days aggravates during night and no relieving factors.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o orthopnea and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o decreased urine output, burning micturition .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o nocturia, polyuria\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o nausea, vomiting, loose stools, constipation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o fever,\u0026nbsp; Year old male with C\/O aphasia and generalised weakness "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"This is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E32 year old male resident of chityala came to casualty with c\/o \ngeneralised weakness since 2 days \ndifficulty in talking since 2 hrs\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;HOPI : \nPatient was apparently asymptomatic 2 hours ago . He started to have difficulty in talking since 2 hours (Acc to pt he started having it after having soft drink ) .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;No h\/o deviation \/ angulation of mouth\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;No h\/o deviation of tongue\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;No h\/o nausea, vomiting and head ache\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;No h\/o tingling sensation in limbs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;No h\/o perioral numbness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o slurring of speech .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Past history : \nPatient had two episodes of seizures in past\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;1) When patient was in seventh standard he got an electric shock and was immediately taken to hospital for treatment and recovered.Later after 3-4 days after this incident patient had an episode of seizures , associated with weakness of limbs and foam from mouth + .No h\/o tongue bite , deviation of tongue , angulation of mouth ,perioral numbness at night when he was asleep\u0026nbsp; and was taken to hospital, treated accordingly and used medication for 3 months .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2) 2 nd episode of seizures was seen around 1 month ago around 10 pm at night ( he was in an yoga\u0026nbsp; ashram near srisailam ) which was observed by people around him and immediately they kept keys in his hands\u0026nbsp; and it resolved after half an hour. He was told that he didn't need to go to hospital by those elders in ashram as he was doing\u0026nbsp; yoga and doing meditation regularly.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAt the time of episode - H\/o tongue bite present on the left side , weakness in both limbs present .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o angulation of mouth\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o tingling sensation in limbs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;No h\/o perioral numbness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o slurring of speech .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o fever , sweating\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o nausea , vomiting\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o headache\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;After he came from aashram he went to near by hospital in nalgonda and they advised to get an MRI and gave medication . She noticed swelling in her both lower limbs until ankle , insidious in onset , gradually progressive in nature , Pitting type . No aggravating and relieving factors.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o generalised weakness since 1 week.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIncreased menstrual bleeding since 3 months but duration remained same not associated with clots .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o orthopnea and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o decreased urine output, burning micturition .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o nocturia, polyuria\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o nausea, vomiting, loose stools, constipation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o fever, cough ,cold .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o palpitations, sweating .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O chest pain.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o abdominal distension, abdominal pain.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o hematuria.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo h\/o headache,sleep disturbances.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPAST HISTORY: She is a 43 year old lady who was born as an elder daughter in her family completed her education until 10th standard.She has two younger brothers.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAt the age of 15 she got married and started living with her husband\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 1995 ,she gave birth to her 1st child (male ) but died after 3 days.(NVD)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 1997 ,she gave birth to a girl child who died at the age of 6.(NVD)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ELater with spacing of 3 years she gave birth to her 3rd child who is currently pursuing degree .(NVD )\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 2002 , she gave birth to her 4th child who is a boy . (NVD)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 2004, she gave birth to her 5th child who is a boy .\u0026nbsp; (NVD)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfter 9 months of birth of her 5th child, she had suffered from low back pain , itching in vaginal area for which she visited her gynaecologist,got evaluated.Her doctor told her that she has lesion in her uterus and got treated for it .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere were no symptoms related to it until 2019 ,but in 2019 when she noticed intermenstrual bleeding for 2 months she visited her gynaecologist and took medication.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4 years ago , patient had complaints of generalised weakness and visited her local doctor , blood investigations were done and her Hemoglobin was around 6 gm\/dl .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESo she took iron and folic acid supplements for a month and stopped.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn June 7 2023 , patient came with similar complaints to our OPD , investigations like complete blood picture,serum electrolytes , creatinine and blood urea were done and was advised to get admitted but she wasn't willing to get admitted.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a k\/c\/o Diabetes Mellitus, Hypertension, Tuberculosis,CAD, Thyroid disorders.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMENSTRUAL HISTORY:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMenarche - 13 years\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E28\/5 - regular periods\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEarlier 2- 3\u0026nbsp;
